name: 2D Rotation
description: Construct variable-size colored, dot-pattern and line/circle grids through the official FreeCAD pipeline, with independent geometry and pixel validation.
steps: Select a pattern and inspect its representative original
Record the intended inference, condition, closest foil and distinguishing evidence
Build and render in the FreeCAD application
Check the declared inference and revise the named option or condition if needed
Independently verify pixels and geometry, visually inspect, then publish
